nodes.title: SG-3 · Remove worker config keys
nodes.body:
Context: the worker module and execution backend were deleted in earlier sub-goals. Desired behavior: backend/internal/config, backend/configs/config.example.yaml and backend/cmd/server/main.go hold no worker or execution settings, and config tests match. Expected result: loading still works for the remaining keys (server, auth, git, hosting, storage, contribution, admin, round) and no code reads a removed key. Why: development automation must not live in this repo. Reading the repo shows config.go, config.example.yaml and main.go already contain no worker keys, so the work is to confirm this and lock it with tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given backend/internal/config/config.go, when Config and its nested structs are inspected, then no worker, execution, work root, budget, auto-publish or agent-provider field exists
- Given backend/configs/config.example.yaml, when it is parsed, then it has no worker or execution top-level key
- Given a minimal YAML with only auth.token_secret, when LoadFS runs, then it succeeds and the contribution, round and storage defaults are applied
- Given backend/cmd/server/main.go, when it is read, then it only uses config.Load, cfg.Server.Addr, server.NewScheduler and server.New


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/config/config.go
- In scope: backend/internal/config/config_test.go
- In scope: backend/configs/config.example.yaml
- In scope: backend/cmd/server/main.go
- Out of scope: game/
- Out of scope: backend/internal/contribution
- Out of scope: frontend code
- Out of scope: docs
- Preserve: Existing env overrides STORYFORGE_*
- Preserve: Defaults for contribution, round, storage and auth
- Preserve: hosting.provider key, which is the git hosting provider and not an agent provider


## Technical constraints
- Go module under backend/; tests are unit tests using testing/fstest


## Definition of done
- All slices below are implemented and verified by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Config structs, example YAML and cmd wiring contain no worker or execution keys
nodes.body:
Context: config.go defines Config with Server, Auth, Git, Hosting, Storage, Contribution, Admin and Round only; applyEnv has no worker overrides; config.example.yaml has the same sections; main.go reads only Server.Addr. Desired behavior: this stays true and is guarded so a removed key cannot return. Expected result: a test fails if a worker or execution key reappears in the struct, the example YAML or the env overrides. Why: keeps the repo free of development automation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the Config type, when its top-level fields are listed by reflection, then they are exactly Server, Auth, Git, Hosting, Storage, Contribution, Admin and Round
- Given config.example.yaml, when decoded into a map, then its top-level keys are exactly server, auth, git, hosting, storage, contribution, admin, round
- Given a YAML containing a worker section, when LoadFS runs, then the section is ignored and no config field carries it


## Scope
- In scope: Confirm config.go and main.go hold no removed keys
- In scope: Guard against reintroduction
- Out of scope: Changing kept keys
- Preserve: hosting.provider


## Technical constraints
- Do not add new config keys


## Definition of done
- Act confirmed, Verify test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Config loading still works for the remaining keys and no code reads a removed key
nodes.body:
Context: LoadFS applies defaults for auth, storage, contribution and round, and applyEnv overrides seven keys. Desired behavior: loading is unchanged after worker key removal. Expected result: the shipped config.example.yaml loads through Load with its documented values, and defaults still apply to a minimal file. Why: proves nothing needed by the server was lost.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given backend/configs/config.example.yaml, when config.Load reads it, then it returns no error with Server.Addr :8080, Round.Duration 24h and Contribution.MaxPromptLen 500
- Given a YAML with only auth.token_secret, when LoadFS runs, then Round.SchedulerInterval is 30s, Storage.ContentDir is game/content and Contribution.RateMax is 3
- Given the server and cmd packages, when they are searched, then no reference to a worker or execution config field exists


## Scope
- In scope: Confirm LoadFS defaults, env overrides and main.go use only kept fields
- Out of scope: New config keys
- Preserve: All existing config tests


## Technical constraints
- Use only fstest and the example file path relative to the package


## Definition of done
- Act confirmed, Verify tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
